# Talkpal

> AI-powered language learning platform offering personalized conversation practice and speech recognition across 84+ languages with real-time feedback.

Talkpal is a comprehensive language learning application that leverages artificial intelligence to provide interactive tutoring, pronunciation training, and conversational practice. The platform serves individual learners, educational institutions, and businesses with multilingual support and adaptive learning experiences.

## Key Topics

- AI language tutor
- Conversational practice
- Speech recognition
- Real-time feedback
- Pronunciation training
- 84+ languages
- Personalized learning
- Multilingual support
- Language learning app
- Speaking practice
- Pronunciation feedback
- Free trial
- Enterprise solutions
- Educational platform
- Interactive tutoring

## Core Platform

- [AI Language Teacher - Talkpal](https://talkpal.ai): Talkpal homepage: AI-powered language learning app supporting 84+ languages
- [Learning - Talkpal](https://talkpal.ai/languages): Language selection and learning interface for Talkpal's 84+ supported languages

## Solutions & Products

- [Talkpal for Business - Talkpal](https://talkpal.ai/talkpal-for-business): Enterprise solution for team language skills and professional communication
- [Talkpal for Education - Talkpal](https://talkpal.ai/talkpal-for-education): Educational platform for institutions and students using AI tutoring
